issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §09-b AuthorsGuide/Reference — FHIR data model access: primitive-typed elements expose their System value via the `.value` accessor (the canonical FHIRHelpers conversion pattern, e.g. FHIRHelpers ToInterval uses period."start".value)
issues.evidence: ([Patient] P return P.birthDate) -> ['1980-01-01'] but ([Patient] P return P.birthDate.value) -> [None]; same for O.status.value, (O.value as FHIR.string).value, P.gender.value. Generated SQL fuses the chain into fhirpath_text(P.resource, 'birthDate.value') — FHIRPath has no .value key on primitive scalars -> empty/NULL. Consequently ConvertsToInteger((O.value as FHIR.string).value) filters reject ALL rows while ConvertsToInteger(O.value as String) correctly returns o1 only. Bundled FHIRHelpers.cql (fhir4ds/cql/resources/cql/FHIRHelpers.cql) uses this accessor throughout. Repro: .temp/qa/cql06_explorer3_2026_08_20/probe3.py + isolates
issues.root_cause: _property.py fhirpath chain-merge sites (lines ~700-710, ~741-752, _flatten_fhirpath_source ~1273) append every path segment to the fhirpath literal; segment 'value' after a FHIR-primitive-typed accumulated path must be treated as identity (System value extraction), per FHIR model metadata (models/r4/path2Type.json)

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B §ConvertsToDecimal: 'returns true if its argument is or can be converted to a Decimal'; §ToDecimal: values are limited in precision and scale to the maximum representable (implementation pins 8 fractional digits, rounding — CQL-01 doctrine)
issues.evidence: ConvertsToDecimal('1.123456789') -> False on BOTH backends, but ToDecimal('1.123456789') -> 1.12345679 (rounds). Same for '0.0000000001' (ToDecimal -> 0E-8). _DECIMAL_STRING_RE in fhir4ds/cql/duckdb/udf/conversion.py caps fractional digits at {1,8}, contradicting the To function it mirrors. Any where-ConvertsToDecimal filter drops values ToDecimal accepts.
issues.root_cause: _DECIMAL_STRING_RE too strict; must accept any fractional digit count and rely on integer-digit extent check (scale overflow rounds per ToDecimal)

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B §ToTime: string format is hh:mm:ss.fff (any precision) — the CQL Time type carries NO timezone component (only DateTime literals may carry an offset)
issues.evidence: ConvertsToTime('12:00:00Z') -> True and ConvertsToTime('12:00:00+05:00') -> True on BOTH backends; ToTime('12:00:00+05:00') silently strips the offset -> 'T12:00:00'. _TIME_RE in udf/conversion.py includes an optional (Z|(+|-)hh:mm) group. Per spec these inputs are invalid -> ConvertsTo false / ToTime null.
issues.root_cause: _TIME_RE timezone group admits offsets the CQL Time grammar/format does not define; ToTime's offset-stripping mirrors it
issues.resolution: RECLASSIFIED INTENDED by architect: official cql-tests fixtures (CqlTypeOperatorsTest ToTime2/3/4) mandate offset acceptance with normalization — fixtures outrank spec prose. FIX-phase rejection remediated back to fixture semantics with tz validation (+99:00 still rejected); gate 2832/2832 restored
